answer: The shale report shows the merge explicitly at each orchard. Each collapsed cluster gets one lotus weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 292 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 237 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3705 identities would post 1079 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
